title: tACS for Patients with Post-Stroke Anomia
description: EEG recordings from two chronic post-stroke anomia patients (one left-hemisphere and one right-hemisphere lesion) who took part in an 8-week individualized transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) intervention. Stimulation and non-stimulation phases alternated every two weeks in a single-case ABAB design, with stimulation frequency and montage personalized from each patient's baseline EEG. EEG was recorded during a picture naming task at intervention weeks and follow-ups to assess effects on naming accuracy and latency.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 32-channel Neuroelectrics Starstim-32 system during a picture naming task using standardized stimuli. Sessions took place at weeks 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8 and at follow-ups at weeks 12 and 20. tACS frequency and montage were individualized from initial EEG. Data were processed in EEGLAB and converted to BIDS.
